plan.title: eRFX Items Drawer Rejects Zero Quantity

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding items.
Add the specified product with a valid default quantity so the sheet can be configured.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Enter the invalid zero quantity that the case expects Procol to reject.
Assert the inline refusal states that quantity must be greater than zero.
